item: The markets Stop-branch exception is logged as 'raised during a Stop' (pass and route), and the test pause is patched on csv_feeds' own name, not the shared time module (R376)
summary: Three notes the reads of #1616 left unfolded. A real exception raised outside the fetch while the switch is engaged (a store error) was logged by the pass as 'import failed', although a Stop is not a failure (R317); it now reads 'raised during a Stop' and the route logs it the same way instead of dropping it. The tests' retry-pause stub replaced time.sleep on the shared time module for the length of each test (the class Q measured under R376); it now replaces the name inside csv_feeds only, and test_the_retry_pause_patch_is_scoped_to_csv_feeds_and_never_the_shared_time_module pins that: patching the shared module again fails it. No behaviour change in the tallies or responses.
